twoGenuineSourcesWithVerificationTail.interpretation: Necessary optimistic token-bucket bound only; shared project limits, deployed route limits, online verification throughput and genuine independent sources remain unverified.

authCapacity.arrangement: A candidate is two genuinely separate owner-controlled source hosts, each provisioning 1000 legitimate Auth sessions at the existing policy. Do not spoof forwarding IPs, copy token IDs, manufacture JWTs or change global policy.
authCapacity.remainingProof: Verify the deployed limiter actually permits independent source budgets and no shared lower cap; legitimate source infrastructure/permission, real MFA, actual session persistence, 2000 online Auth+committed session row checks within300s, >=900s remaining lifetime, exact distribution and generator/reference capacity. GET/user verification quota is unresolved. The model is necessary arithmetic, not a working arrangement.

rows.fullStatement: FR-502: Every authoritative command MUST reuse the existing authenticated command, optimistic-version, receipt, audit, and outbox infrastructure; identical retries MUST not duplicate its effects.
rows.nextEvidence: Run the seven committed races, then extend exact retry/version/receipt/audit/outbox checks to every remaining authoritative command family; one forecast duplicate race alone does not close this universal criterion.

rows.fullStatement: FR-508: Analytics reads MUST bound time range, source rows, groups, output, and pages; a limit breach MUST fail explicitly without a partial total.
rows.nextEvidence: Exercise actual installed time/rows/groups/output/pages boundaries across every analytics surface; retain named rejection and zero partial totals, including genuine pagination permission loss.

rows.fullStatement: NFR-503: Interactive pages MUST default to 50 rows and cap at 200; synchronous calculations MUST cap at 10,000 source rows, 100 groups, 366 days, and 8 MiB serialized output, unless a later approved slice sets tighter bounds.
rows.nextEvidence: Verify actual default50/cap200 pages and exact 10000rows/100groups/366UTCdays/8MiB boundaries. Three over-limit fixture populations exceed or are absent from the existing reviewed preparation; do not fabricate evidence.

rows.fullStatement: NFR-504: Indexed ordinary reads MUST meet p95 below 500 ms and ordinary commands below 1.5 s at the published workload on the reference environment; target-scale evidence MUST cover 500 tenants and 2,000 concurrent sessions.
rows.nextEvidence: Run the published 500-scope/2000 genuine-session 60s+300s protocol and independently audit actual dispatch trace, zero errors and strict P95 read<500ms/command<1500ms on a recorded reference environment.

rows.fullStatement: NFR-505: Larger allowed work MUST use bounded resumable jobs with explicit cancellation/failure state and at most 1,000 rows per committed chunk; synchronous bounded analytic calculations MUST target p95 below 3 s.
rows.nextEvidence: Identify/implement the allowed large analytics job path with durable scoped progress, <=1000rows/committed chunk, failure/cancellation/resume and source authorization; the reviewed load provider contains no implementation or live demonstration of that job lifecycle. Measure bounded analytics P95<3000ms.

rows.fullStatement: NFR-506: At least 100 duplicate requests and independent overlapping-session tests MUST demonstrate one authoritative effect per command/invocation/event and no hard-quota overshoot; sequential SQL MUST not count as contention proof.
rows.nextEvidence: Run all seven genuine independent overlapping committed races (100duplicates,2seats,2admissions,2activation,2execution,2leases,20quota); preserve winner/loser effects and no overshoot. Controlled barriers are preparation only.

rows.fullStatement: AC-503: Bounded calculations (FR-508, NFR-503, NFR-504, NFR-505) Given limit-boundary datasets and a published reference workload When reads, calculations, or jobs execute Then limits reject excess atomically and measured latency meets the stated budget.
rows.nextEvidence: Combine installed exact-boundary rejection/zero-effect evidence, allowed resumable job evidence and the actual reference-workload latency report; these are three distinct unclosed dependencies.

rows.fullStatement: EC-514: Date-range/source/group/output limit, job crash, cancellation or unavailable database worker returns a named state without partial total; verify with AC-503.
rows.nextEvidence: Inject bounded job crash, cancellation and unavailable worker failures in an isolated reviewed fixture; verify named state, no partial totals, durable progress and safe resume without replaying uncertain effects.

rows.fullStatement: NFR-552: Snapshots MUST reject more than 10,000 source rows, 100 groups, 366 UTC days, or 8 MiB output; pages MUST default to 50 and cap at 200.
rows.nextEvidence: Exercise exact and over-limit process snapshot time/rows/groups/output/page boundaries through the installed adapter, with zero partial totals and no hidden truncation.

rows.fullStatement: AC-555: Bounded complete snapshot (FR-552, NFR-552) Given page truncation, duplicate identities and source/group/time/output boundaries When a snapshot is submitted Then incomplete or over-limit input fails without a partial result and allowed boundary input succeeds.
rows.nextEvidence: Prove actual paginated source completeness, duplicate identity rejection and allowed/excess source/group/time/output boundaries; fresh controlled arithmetic is narrower than installed pagination evidence.

rows.fullStatement: EC-557: Pagination loses permission or reaches a retrieval cap, malformed UTC, inverted window or oversized output fails without partial totals; covered by AC-555/558.
rows.nextEvidence: Run real pagination permission loss/retrieval-cap cases plus malformed UTC/inverted windows/oversized serialized output, and verify all-or-nothing failure with protected aggregates cleared.

historicReview.limitation: The old 18-source harness and load package reviews remain historical. Coordinator/CLI changed and imported trace module is new; execution requires a separate successor source review and concrete private/live prerequisites.

acceptanceRecommendation: Keep all eleven rows open. Authoritative execution, full installed limits, genuine target-scale load and allowed resumable jobs need their own evidence. No controlled test count closes those gates.
